title: NotesApp
summary: React Native app plus a FastAPI API: 18 endpoints, 15 migrations, Google OAuth and rotating JWTs.

headline: NotesApp: a notes app I took from schema to signed APK
intro: A React Native app on top of a FastAPI backend I designed, secured and deployed myself. Two repos, one product, every layer mine.
role: Everything: product, database, API, auth, mobile UI, deployment and release.

items.title: Auth done properly
items.text: Email and Google sign-in sharing one session layer, email OTP verification and password recovery, and JWTs with automatic refresh-token rotation.

items.title: Rich-text editor
items.text: A markdown-inspired editor with headings, links, lists, quotes and language-aware code blocks, plus a built-in formatting guide.

items.title: Excel export
items.text: Notes exported to a spreadsheet, with task status tracking from pending to in progress to completed.

items.title: Config API
items.text: App version checks, force updates, maintenance mode and the About and Privacy pages all come from the server, so behaviour changes without a release.

items.title: Schema that evolves
items.text: PostgreSQL with SQLAlchemy and 15 Alembic migrations, so every change to the database is versioned.

items.title: Shipped, not just coded
items.text: API on Render with Neon Postgres and Resend for email; the Android APK on GitHub Releases; MIT licensed.

sections.title: What it taught me
items: Designing reusable auth flows so two sign-in methods share one session layer
Structuring a React Native codebase by feature, with shared components and centralized API services
Building and versioning a production REST API and its database
Preparing an app and an API for cloud deployment and a public release
